description: This file defines some FastAPI dependency functions using async generators and the Depends system to manage dependencies between different components (DepA, DepB, DepC). It demonstrates dependency chaining and resource management in an asynchronous FastAPI context.

methods.name: dependency_a()
methods.description: Asynchronous generator function providing dependency a, manages resource cleanup via 'close()' method.

methods.name: dependency_b(dep_a: Annotated[DepA, Depends(dependency_a)])
methods.description: Asynchronous generator function depending on dependency_a, manages resource cleanup via 'close()' method.

methods.name: dependency_c(dep_b: Annotated[DepB, Depends(dependency_b)])
methods.description: Asynchronous generator function depending on dependency_b, manages resource cleanup via 'close()' method.
